prompt.text: A fictional luxury perfume object stands alone on a shallow plane of black liquid: a squat rectangular bottle of translucent smoky obsidian glass, slightly wider at the shoulders, with one clean diagonal facet across its front-left face, no label, and an asymmetrical brushed-silver collar supporting a low black stone cap. A single amber perfume droplet is suspended inside the glass near the upper-left shoulder. In one continuous five-second macro product shot, begin at bottle height and make a slow physically plausible twenty-degree arc from front-left toward center while the bottle rises two centimeters through the liquid. A thin silver petal ring rotates clockwise around the collar. End before the motion resolves: one petal is crossing the bottle's front-right edge, a narrow droplet trail is descending on the exterior left face, and the cap remains fully closed. A large soft white source stays camera-left and a narrow amber source glows from below; reflections must follow the facet and camera movement. Dense glass, viscous liquid, restrained ripples, no floating dust, no text, no logo, no extra bottle, no cap transformation, no cut.
